capabilities: Transform each vault file into an orbital body via a one-way cryptographic hash
Upload only orbital parameters (radius, eccentricity, size, color) to a hosted galaxy
Sync the whole vault or a configured folder on demand
Delete a system using the vault that originally created it
Configure system name, star grouping, and sync folder
disambiguation: Not a vault sync or backup tool; "sync" only uploads derived orbital metadata to a public gallery, and nothing ever restores your notes from it.
extras: Self-described as "a science-based art project"; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; viewing the result requires the external site cosmos.supermagicapps.com.
problem: Obsidian has no way to publicly visualize the shape of a writing practice without exposing note contents, file names, or vault structure.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects to a hosted Supabase database to store and retrieve orbital metadata.

requires.name: Cosmos hosted service (cosmos.supermagicapps.com, backed by Supabase)

summary: Vault visualizer that renders each note as a body in a shared online solar system, uploading only derived orbital parameters, never text.
